title: Ruhun da Ba a San Suna Ba wanda Ya Tsayayya da Al'umma Mara Adalci
intro: A cikin shafukan Alƙur'ani, akwai mutane waɗanda aka ɓoye sunayensu domin mu yi tunani a kan darussansu. An haifi wata irin wannan rai a cikin al'ummar da ta ƙi manzanninta, amma wannan mutumin yana da wani ɓoyeccen imani wanda ya keɓe su. Lokacin da halaka ta zo, wannan mutumin ya tsaya tsayin daka a cikin imaninsa na sirri. Za ku iya gano asalin wannan mutum mai ban mamaki wanda ke gargaɗin mutanensa kafin a zartar da hukunci na ƙarshe?
clues: Na zauna a cikin mutanen da suka yi ta musanta manzannin da Allah ya aiko musu akai-akai.
Sabanin al'ummata, na gane gaskiya lokacin da wani manzo ya zo da hujjoji bayyanannu daga Ubangijina.
Na ɓoye imanina daga masu zaluntara, na san za su cutar da ni idan suka gano imanina.
Lokacin da umarnin hukunci ya gabato, na bayyana biyayyata a fili kuma na yi wa mutanena gargaɗi su ceci kansu.
Na tunatar da su cewa ni amintaccen manzo ne, ba shi da bambanci da waɗanda aka aiko a baya, kuma bai kamata su bauta wa Allah ba.
Mutanena sun zarge ni da sihiri da hauka, amma duk da haka hukuncin da aka yi musu gargaɗi a ƙarshe ya same su.

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Annabi Hud, manzon mutanen Aad
Mutum mumini daga al'ummar Annabi Hud wanda aka yi shahada
Mai mulkin mutanen Adawa wanda ya ƙi gaskiya
Sahabin Annabi Salih wanda ya yi shakkar alamun Allah
An aiko mala'ika don ya halaka mutanen Adawa
identity.answer: Mutum mumini daga al'ummar Annabi Hud wanda aka yi shahada

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Jarabawar fari da yunwa wadda ta gwada haƙurinsu
Jarabawar bayyana imani a gaban al'umma mai zalunci marasa imani
Gwajin gina jirgin ruwa don gujewa ambaliyar ruwa mai yawa
Jarabawar jefa shi cikin wuta saboda imani da Allah
Jarabawar da za a gwada da wadata da wadata
trial.answer: Jarabawar bayyana imani a gaban al'umma mai zalunci marasa imani

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Birnin Makkah inda aka gina gidan alfarma
Filayen hamada na al'ummar da suka ƙaryata manzonsu
Duwatsun Madyana inda aka aiko Annabi Shu'aib
Gaɓar kogin Masar inda aka sami Annabi Musa
Kwarin mutanen Adawa, wanda iska mai ƙarfi ta buge shi
location.answer: Filayen hamada na al'ummar da suka ƙaryata manzonsu

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An cece ni a cikin jirgin ruwa kuma na rayu har sai Allah ya so
Mutanena sun yi imani bayana kuma an shiryar da su zuwa ga hanya madaidaiciya
Mutane na ne suka kashe ni amma rahamar Allah ta ɗauke raina
Na tuba bayan an jarabce ni kuma Allah ya karɓi tubata
An mayar da ni gunki wanda mutanena ke bautawa bayan mutuwata
outcome.answer: Mutane na ne suka kashe ni amma rahamar Allah ta ɗauke raina

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verse: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority (11:96)
